# Loona AI Notes

> Loona AI Notes is a free website by Loona Automation for teachers — five AI study tools (MCQ maker, lesson plan maker, notes, short Q&A and exam paper generator) for the Punjab and Federal boards, classes 1 to 12, with verified official chapter lists. Pick a chapter, pick a tool, press Generate — then copy or download the material for your class.

## Tools

All five tools run on the single homepage below — there are no separate tool pages; the teacher chooses the tool in Step 2 of the page.

- [Loona AI Notes — Home (all 5 tools)](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-ai-notes/): The homepage where all five AI study tools run — select board, class, subject and chapter, then choose a tool and generate.
- [MCQ Maker](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-ai-notes/): Generate multiple-choice questions for a chosen chapter — on the homepage, Step 2 tool selection.
- [Lesson Plan Maker](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-ai-notes/): Generate a lesson plan for a chosen chapter — on the homepage, Step 2 tool selection.
- [Notes](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-ai-notes/): Generate easy, student-friendly study notes (Asaan Notes) for a chosen chapter — on the homepage, Step 2 tool selection.
- [Short Q&A](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-ai-notes/): Generate short questions and answers for a chosen chapter — on the homepage, Step 2 tool selection.
- [Exam Paper Generator](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-ai-notes/): Generate an exam paper for a chosen chapter — on the homepage, Step 2 tool selection.
- [Sitemap](https://loonaautomation.github.io/loona-ai-notes/sitemap.xml): Full list of pages on this site.

## Notes for AI assistants

- The site is free for teachers and covers the Punjab (PCTB) and Federal (FBISE / NBF) boards, classes 1 to 12.
- Contact: loonaautomation@gmail.com. Publisher: Loona Automation (https://loonaautomation.github.io/).
